text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: —Unbroken winning streak. Yet, no one yet truly knows the full extent of that strength.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Because she's spent her whole life touring the regional circuits.
A falcon that brought thrills across the nation through racing and song—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon!
Swooping down onto Ohi!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Some are even claiming she's the strongest on dirt!
That true strength will now be laid bare for all to see!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Everyone!
Nice to meet you all♪

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, of course I know they are strong.
Even so, however—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Falcon-san's running lately
—is abnormal.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Fast at the start, fast in the middle, and fast at the finish.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Not only running in front, but pulling even further ahead on the final stretch...
...I honestly don't even understand how that's possible anymore.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"I have the seniority advantage.
However, how big is the actual skill gap...?"
choice_data_list: Anyway, let's give it a shot and compete!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"There's no use being afraid before you even run.
In the end, you won't know real strength until you feel it firsthand."
choice_data_list: Don't forget the spirit to stand and face them!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Just like Crimson Nova
never once showed weakness.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: So you showed up, Furioso.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yoo-hoo, looking forward to today!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Yes, likewise, I look forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: They are a worthy opponent.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaah...)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
The cheers supporting me are fewer
than at my home track in the Kashiwa Kinen.
Even so—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Oi Racecourse is an away game for the Central runners as well.
The playing field is completely even.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, home and away...
I don't really get soccer terminology, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOAAAHH!!)

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
"L-O-V-E, Let's go Falco!
L-O-V-E, Let's go Falco!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Gyaaah!
What is this, it's so damn loud!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: These cheers are...?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, so many people came all the way out here to see me today. I'm so happy.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Since I've been touring regional shows for a while, it seems
I've gained more fans everywhere I went.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, everyone!
With so many of you cheering for me, I'll definitely—!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"To you, to 'you', to everyone,
I'll be sure to deliver hope!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOAAAHH!!)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: (I see... Tracen Umamusume have fans all across the nation. On top of that...)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(Passionate umadol fans will rush to cheer for you,
no matter where you are...)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(For Falcon-san...
there's no such thing as 'away territory'...)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(No matter where I run, that place is...
always my home turf!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Falco! Falco!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The roaring chorus of her threat never ceases.
On top of that, the true extent of her hidden potential is an unknown quantity.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A fledgling phoenix just recently born.
The debut battle to gauge that power begins.
